title: ChatGPT Time Capsule: Additional Actionable Details Not in Yesterday's Stage
rationale: Yesterday's stage (2026-04-27/1_chatgpt_time_capsule_r28_r33.json) captured the high-level finding. Today's deep-read of the full HTML paper revealed three additional actionable details not previously staged: (1) Model sophistication gradient — within the same knowledge cutoff, larger models extract stronger return-predictive signals (GPT-4.1 gamma=0.0122 vs GPT-4.1-mini gamma=0.0093 vs GPT-4.1-nano gamma=0.0065). This implies that for R28 Phase 2 EarningsQualityAgent sub-agents, using Claude-Haiku (smallest) vs Claude-Sonnet (larger) matters: upgrade worker agents for quality judgment calls from Haiku to Sonnet-4.6, reserving Haiku for only cheap high-volume classification tasks. (2) Horizon convergence — 12-month coefficient is 5x 1-month coefficient (beta=0.0683 at 12m vs 0.0122 at 1m, both significant). PEAD is fundamentally a short-term phenomenon (<30 days), but the LLM fundamental quality score generates multi-month drift — this is a DISTINCT signal from PEAD. R34 concept should use LLM quality z-score as a 6-12 month fundamental momentum signal, not just a PEAD filter gate. (3) Narrative congestion mechanism — the signal is STRONGER for high analyst coverage stocks (t=2.44 for coverage interaction). For large-cap PEAD signals (our universe), this means LLM quality scoring should be MORE reliable than for micro-caps, because large-caps have richer public information environments that LLMs aggregate better. This validates R28 architecture applied to our S&P 500 / Fortune 100 universe.
content:
### ChatGPT Time Capsule: Additional Insights from Deep Read (arXiv:2604.21433)
- **Model sophistication gradient (NEW)**: Within same knowledge cutoff, larger models produce stronger signals. GPT-4.1: γ=0.0122; GPT-4.1-mini: γ=0.0093; GPT-4.1-nano: γ=0.0065. Improvement is ~30% from mini→full model. **R28 Phase 2 implication**: Use Claude-Sonnet-4.6 (not Haiku) for the Risk sub-agent and for final quality consolidation. Use Haiku only for high-volume binary classification (direct/evasive NOR detection where Eva-4B already outperforms). Cost uplift: ~3x per Sonnet call vs Haiku — but only ~30 events/quarter, so negligible absolute cost (~$0.45/quarter additional).
- **Horizon convergence (NEW)**: LLM fundamental quality signal is 5x stronger at 12 months than 1 month (β₁ₘ=0.0122, β₁₂ₘ=0.0683). PEAD (R28) exploits short-term drift (5-30 days). But the same LLM quality signal generates multi-month fundamental momentum. **R34 amendment**: Add LLM sector-neutral z-score as a 6-12 month position-sizing modifier in the Dividend Raise strategy — high-z-score dividend raisers get 1.5x position size at entry. Different signal source (fundamental quality vs technical pattern), same asset universe.
- **Narrative congestion mechanism validates large-cap focus (NEW)**: Signal STRENGTHENS with analyst coverage (t=2.44). Our S&P 500/Fortune 100 PEAD universe is high-analyst-coverage by definition. LLM quality scoring is most predictive exactly WHERE we apply it. The paper's mechanism is 'information aggregation bottleneck' — markets struggle to process dispersed qualitative signals across many documents. LLM aggregates more efficiently than individual analysts or momentum traders. This is a DURABLE mechanism (not statistical artifact).
- **Source**: arXiv:2604.21433 (Lehner & Lopez-Lira, April 23, 2026)
